winner.text: Increase only L2 regularization on the existing additive context model to reduce sparse-context overfitting.
winner.rationale: Official diagnostics show very weak sparse context cells, especially tab 8 with nDCG@5 0.026 and tab 0 with nDCG@5 0.062, while the full model's aggregate metrics remain moderate. Stronger regularization is a clean non-feature intervention that may stabilize rare tab and hour offsets.
winner.exact_ablation: Change only L2 from 1e-6 to 1e-4 for all additive weights; retain the current user/video/tab/weekday/hour features, BCE objective, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, and stopping rule unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Small uncertain change, approximately -0.0010 to +0.0020; shrinkage may improve rare-context generalization but can weaken useful user/video separation.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Small possible increase, approximately -0.0010 to +0.0025, if extreme sparse offsets currently displace good candidates; excessive shrinkage may flatten top-five scores.

selection_rationale: Select c12 because it is the consultant's top-ranked experiment and offers the best risk-adjusted opportunity: low runtime and leakage risk, highest confidence among the leading options, and direct targeting of severe sparse-context failures in tabs 8 and 0 through stronger regularization. Its expected gain is modest but more reliable than the higher-risk architecture and loss changes.
